messages:
Ava: Quick sketch  propose a small 'Kickstart Surge' experiment tied to our next public workshop. Give new users a 50-token kickoff + a tiny promptpack (3 curated templates) when they both register and attend. Primary goal: measure incremental 7-day activation (>=5 API calls or completing 1 chat scenario).

Ravi: Sounds good. Suggest 3 arms: control / lightweight email / email + immediate in-app experience (overlay + auto-insert promptpack). Keeps it clean for attribution. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Routing idea  for signed-in users show an in-app banner and overlay after they RSVP; for new emails send a claim link in the confirmation email that redeems to a landing page. Landing should pre-seed the promptpack into quickstart.

Sam (growth): I'll randomize at RSVP to avoid bias and spin up cohorts in Amplitude. Need the event schema and expected props. Also will add UTMs for paid vs organic attribution.

Ava: Proposed arms:
- Arm A: baseline (no special outreach)
- Arm B: email-only (confirmation + one follow-up with claim CTA)
- Arm C: email + in-app banner + overlay that highlights 3 starter prompts + a "Run one now" button (auto-insert promptpack on first session)
Measurement window: gift redeemable 14 days post-workshop; primary metrics at 7 and 14 days.

Ravi: Email subject guidance  avoid the word "free". Options: "Your Redwood Kickstart Toolkit" or "Kickstart: templates + starter tokens". I prefer the first. Keep preheader short and action-oriented.

Priya: I'll draft 2 email variants (short / example-led) and 2 banner lengths. Email should include 1-2 sample prompts inline so recipients can see immediate value.

Sam (growth): Event list to capture: 
```
- workshop_registered
- workshop_attended
- kickstart_claimed (prop: arm, code)
- first_api_call (prop: success)
- prompt_used (prop: template_id)
- overlay_shown
- overlay_action (run_now/copy)
- tour_started
- tour_completed
```
Also properties: user_cohort (A/B/C), signup_source, utm_campaign, utm_variant.

prod-bot: Ops note  promo tokens must be single-use, TTL=14d. Use POST /promo/generate with marketing-scoped key. Landing pattern: /kickstart/claim/<code>. Landing fires kickstart_claimed and redirects to /quickstart?preload=promptpack_id.

Ava: Can we make the overlay lightweight: 3 cards with short descriptions + one-click run -> triggers first_api_call and copies the prompt to the workspace. Track run_immediate as an event.

Ravi: Add a tiny A/B in the overlay copy: CTA=Run vs CTA=Explore templates. Might affect conversion.

Sam (growth): I'll produce sample-size estimates tomorrow. Tentative targets: Arm C claim rate 18-25%, Arm B 7-11%, control 2-4%. Target 7-day activation lift +8-12pp vs control. Will formalize with CIs.

Priya: I'll upload copy drafts to the marketing drive and drop the link here when ready. Also will @legal for token language and TTL mention.

Ava: Quick checklist:
- Amplitude cohort + event spec (Sam)
- Promo token generation + scoped key (prod-bot)
- Claim landing + redirect + analytics (prod-bot)
- Email + banner + overlay copy (Priya)
- Promptpack + 3 exemplar prompts (Ava)
- Legal sign-off for token terms (Priya/Legal)
- QA plan for email/banner/landing (Ravi)

Ravi: I'll QA copy and visuals on Thu. Sam, ping me when cohorts are live and I'll sanity-check attribution.

Sam (growth): Will ping here when sample sizes are in and cohorts are ready. Planning to randomize at RSVP and record assignment in signup props.

Ava: If everyone is aligned, lock arms tomorrow and schedule a 20m sync after Priya posts drafts.

Priya: Posting drafts Wed 10am PT, tagging legal.

Ravi: :thumbsup: Let's keep the landing super simple so we can iterate quickly.
